layout_and_grids.spacing_philosophy: Generous and dense hybrid. Padding p-6 to p-8 inside cards to avoid text collision.
layout_and_grids.hero_layout: Asymmetric hero with interactive toggle ('I'M LOOKING FOR' vs 'I'M OFFERING') leading into quick search bar and category cards.
layout_and_grids.marketplace_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8. Filter Sidebar: col-span-12 lg:col-span-3. Listing Feed: col-span-12 lg:col-span-9.
layout_and_grids.dashboard_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Sidebar Nav: col-span-1. Main Content / Metrics: col-span-3.

navigation_header.style: Sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/85 dark:bg-slate-900/85 border-b border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800 px-4 lg:px-8 py-3.5

hero_toggle.seeker_mode: I'm Looking For... (Jobs, Visiting Consultant, Clinic Space, Practice Buyout, MDS/Fellowships)
hero_toggle.giver_mode: I'm Offering / Posting... (Associate Jobs, Clinic Space Rentals, Practice Transfer, Dental Equipment, Courses)
hero_toggle.styling: Pill-shaped dual toggle with smooth spring animation, active emerald highlight and amber accent ring.

opportunity_cards.structure: Bordered card with subtle hover translation (-translate-y-1), shadow-sm to shadow-md transition.

steps: Select Category (Job / Visiting Consultant / Clinic Space / Practice Transfer / MDS Fellowship / Equipment / Services)

Requirements & Perks (Experience level, Equipment available, Working hours)

features: Pending Verification Queue (DCI Certificates, Clinic Licenses)

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive components (buttons, filters, tabs, inputs, modals) include descriptive data-testid attributes.
DO NOT use generic bright hospital-blue styling. Use the Warm Emerald (#065F46 / #047857) and Amber Gold (#D97706) color palette provided.
Implement two-sided marketplace user flows seamlessly: Seeker View (Look for jobs/spaces/courses) vs Giver View (Post jobs/list clinic space/offer equipment).
Include verification badges across listing cards, dentist profiles, and clinic profiles to reflect trust levels.
Use Lucide React icons for all dental/medical/business icons.
Ensure standard modal overlays and dropdown menus have semi-opaque background blurs (never transparent or pitch black without blur).

Provide filtering by Indian States & Cities (e.g. Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, Ahmedabad) and Specialties (Endodontics, Orthodontics, Prosthodontics, Periodontics, Oral Surgery, Pedodontics, Oral Medicine/Pathology, General Dentistry).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.test_id_rule: Every button, input, link, tab, card, and modal MUST contain a kebab-case data-testid attribute.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_overlays: Never use bg-transparent for dropdowns, popovers, or floating headers. Use backdrop-blur with bg-white/90 or bg-slate-900/90.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.motion: Use framer-motion for smooth entrance transitions, filter tab switches, and wizard step changes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.responsiveness: Mobile-first layouts with accessible tap targets (min 44px) for doctors using mobile phones on the move.
